status: DRAFT: every Swahili line must be checked by a native Tanzanian Swahili speaker before any audio is generated. Record the reviewer's name and the date in docs/DATA_SOURCES.md.

conventions.slots: Slots always come at the END of a Swahili phrase (Swahili puts the number after the noun), so audio = phrase clip + unit clip + number clip. English: phrase clip (words up to the first slot) + slot clips in English order + {id}__END for words after the last slot (app/src/lib/clips.ts).
conventions.noun_class: Swahili numbers agree with the noun class. hekta/ekari/asilimia (N-class) use numbers_n; miaka (MI-class) uses numbers_mi. A naive template engine gets this wrong; that's why the two lists are kept separate.
conventions.rounding: Area: nearest 0.5 (numbers_n + HALF). Percent: nearest 10 (tens). Years: harvest year of the season (2021/22 -> 2022).

phrases.en: This app helps you make an evidence report about your farm. It records your voice, photos, and where your farm is.
phrases.sw: Programu hii inakusaidia kuandaa ripoti ya ushahidi kuhusu shamba lako. Inarekodi sauti yako, picha, na mahali shamba lako lilipo.

phrases.en: Nothing leaves this phone unless you agree. Your voice recording stays on this phone.
phrases.sw: Hakuna kitakachotoka kwenye simu hii bila idhini yako. Rekodi ya sauti yako inabaki kwenye simu hii.

phrases.en: Do you agree? Tap the green button for yes, or the red button for no.
phrases.sw: Je, unakubali? Gusa kitufe cha kijani kusema ndiyo, au kitufe chekundu kusema hapana.

phrases.en: You can delete everything at any time.
phrases.sw: Unaweza kufuta kila kitu wakati wowote.

phrases.en: Okay. Nothing was recorded.
phrases.sw: Sawa. Hakuna kilichorekodiwa.

phrases.en: Tell us about your farm: what you grow, how big it is, how long you have been in the cooperative, and any bad seasons.
phrases.sw: Tueleze kuhusu shamba lako: unalima nini, lina ukubwa gani, umekuwa mwanachama wa chama cha ushirika kwa muda gani, na misimu yoyote mibaya.

phrases.en: Is this correct? Tap yes or no.
phrases.sw: Je, hii ni sahihi? Gusa ndiyo au hapana.

phrases.en: Walk along the edge of your farm. The phone will draw the boundary.
phrases.sw: Tembea kando ya mpaka wa shamba lako. Simu itachora mpaka huo.

phrases.en: Or draw the boundary of your farm on the map with your finger.
phrases.sw: Au chora mpaka wa shamba lako kwenye ramani kwa kidole chako.

phrases.en: Stand inside your farm and take a photo of your crops.
phrases.sw: Simama ndani ya shamba lako na upige picha ya mazao yako.

phrases.en: Now turn around and take one more photo.
phrases.sw: Sasa geuka nyuma upige picha moja zaidi.

phrases.en: This photo is outside your farm boundary. Please go inside your farm and try again.
phrases.sw: Picha hii iko nje ya mpaka wa shamba lako. Tafadhali ingia ndani ya shamba ujaribu tena.

phrases.en: The phone cannot find its location. Move to an open place and wait a moment.
phrases.sw: Simu haiwezi kupata mahali ilipo. Nenda mahali pa wazi na usubiri kidogo.

phrases.en: Thank you. Your report is being prepared on this phone.
phrases.sw: Asante. Ripoti yako inaandaliwa kwenye simu hii.

phrases.en: This is your evidence report. Listen to it, then decide if you want to share it.
phrases.sw: Hii ni ripoti yako ya ushahidi. Isikilize, kisha uamue kama unataka kuishiriki.

phrases.en: Satellite or weather records agree with this.
phrases.sw: Kumbukumbu za satelaiti au hali ya hewa zinakubaliana na hili.

phrases.en: Your cooperative has confirmed this.
phrases.sw: Chama chako cha ushirika kimethibitisha hili.

phrases.en: Your extension officer has confirmed this.
phrases.sw: Afisa ugani wako amethibitisha hili.

phrases.en: The records do not agree with this. The loan officer may ask you about it.
phrases.sw: Kumbukumbu hazikubaliani na hili. Afisa mikopo anaweza kukuuliza kuhusu hili.

phrases.en: This could not be checked. It stays as your own statement.
phrases.sw: Hili halikuweza kukaguliwa. Linabaki kuwa maelezo yako mwenyewe.

phrases.en: You said you grow coffee.
phrases.sw: Ulisema unalima kahawa.

phrases.en: You said you grow maize.
phrases.sw: Ulisema unalima mahindi.

phrases.en: You said you grow coffee with bananas.
phrases.sw: Ulisema unalima kahawa pamoja na migomba.

phrases.en: Satellite pictures of your farm look like coffee, which stays green all year.
phrases.sw: Picha za satelaiti za shamba lako zinaonekana kama kahawa, ambayo hubaki kijani mwaka mzima.

phrases.en: Satellite pictures of your farm look like a seasonal crop such as maize, not coffee.
phrases.sw: Picha za satelaiti za shamba lako zinaonekana kama zao la msimu kama mahindi, si kahawa.

phrases.en: Satellite pictures are not clear enough to tell which crop is on your farm.
phrases.sw: Picha za satelaiti hazionyeshi wazi zao lililopo shambani kwako.

phrases.en: Your photos appear to show coffee plants.
phrases.sw: Picha zako zinaonekana kuonyesha mimea ya kahawa.

phrases.en: Your photos do not appear to show coffee plants.
phrases.sw: Picha zako hazionekani kuonyesha mimea ya kahawa.

phrases.en: All your photos were taken inside your farm.
phrases.sw: Picha zako zote zilipigwa ndani ya shamba lako.

phrases.en: One photo looks the same as a photo in another report. A person will check this.
phrases.sw: Picha moja inafanana na picha iliyo kwenye ripoti nyingine. Mtu atakagua hili.

phrases.en: You said your farm is {number} {unit}.
phrases.sw: Ulisema shamba lako lina {unit} {number}.

phrases.en: The farm you drew on the map is about {number} {unit}.
phrases.sw: Shamba ulilochora kwenye ramani lina takriban {unit} {number}.

phrases.en: You said the bad season was in {year}.
phrases.sw: Ulisema msimu mbaya ulikuwa mwaka {year}.

phrases.en: Rainfall records show that season had about {percent} percent less rain than normal.
phrases.sw: Kumbukumbu za mvua zinaonyesha msimu huo ulikuwa na mvua chache kuliko kawaida, kwa takriban asilimia {percent}.

phrases.en: Rainfall was normal that season, so the cause may be something else, like pests, disease, or soil. Your extension officer can help find out.
phrases.sw: Mvua zilikuwa za kawaida msimu huo, kwa hiyo sababu inaweza kuwa nyingine, kama wadudu, magonjwa au udongo. Afisa ugani anaweza kukusaidia kujua sababu.

phrases.en: That season was also hotter than normal.
phrases.sw: Msimu huo pia ulikuwa na joto kuliko kawaida.

phrases.en: You said you have been a cooperative member for {number} years.
phrases.sw: Ulisema umekuwa mwanachama wa chama cha ushirika kwa miaka {number}.
phrases.note: number = 1 needs 'kwa mwaka mmoja'; use COOP_SAID_ONE.

phrases.en: You said you have been a cooperative member for one year.
phrases.sw: Ulisema umekuwa mwanachama wa chama cha ushirika kwa mwaka mmoja.

phrases.en: You told us how much coffee you delivered last season.
phrases.sw: Ulituambia kiasi cha kahawa ulichowasilisha msimu uliopita.
phrases.note: Quantity shown on screen only; no number clips above 20.

phrases.en: This report does not show who owns the land.
phrases.sw: Ripoti hii haionyeshi nani anamiliki ardhi hii.

phrases.en: To show this, your cooperative can co-sign, or you can add a land document.
phrases.sw: Ili kuonyesha hili, chama chako kinaweza kusaini, au unaweza kuongeza hati ya ardhi.

phrases.en: Soil maps suggest your soil may be acidic. This is only an estimate. Ask your extension officer before buying anything.
phrases.sw: Ramani za udongo zinaonyesha kwamba udongo wako unaweza kuwa na tindikali. Haya ni makadirio tu. Muulize afisa ugani kabla ya kununua chochote.

phrases.en: We are not sure about some parts of this report. Please talk to your extension officer or cooperative before sharing it.
phrases.sw: Hatuna uhakika kuhusu baadhi ya sehemu za ripoti hii. Tafadhali zungumza na afisa ugani au chama chako kabla ya kuishiriki.

phrases.en: This report is evidence, not a guarantee. It does not approve or refuse a loan. A person will decide.
phrases.sw: Ripoti hii ni ushahidi, si hakikisho. Haikubali wala haikatai mkopo. Mtu ndiye atakayeamua.

phrases.en: The loan officer may visit your farm to check.
phrases.sw: Afisa mikopo anaweza kutembelea shamba lako ili kukagua.

phrases.en: Do you want to share this report with the loan officer? Tap the green button for yes, or the red button for no.
phrases.sw: Je, unataka kushiriki ripoti hii na afisa mikopo? Gusa kitufe cha kijani kusema ndiyo, au kitufe chekundu kusema hapana.

phrases.en: The report is sealed. Show this code to the loan officer.
phrases.sw: Ripoti imefungwa. Mwonyeshe afisa mikopo msimbo huu.

phrases.en: The report was not shared. It stays on this phone.
phrases.sw: Ripoti haijashirikiwa. Inabaki kwenye simu hii.

phrases.en: Everything has been deleted from this phone.
phrases.sw: Kila kitu kimefutwa kwenye simu hii.

phrases.en: Tap here to listen again.
phrases.sw: Gusa hapa kusikiliza tena.

numbers_n.note: Appended after a whole number: mbili na nusu = 2.5

lender_only.en: Ownership is not shown. Satellites cannot see land rights; only a cooperative co-sign or a land document can.
GPS location can be faked on some phones. Freshness photos and satellite history reduce, but do not remove, this risk.
In-app camera only, but a modified phone could inject images. A site visit is the backstop.
Rainfall is a ~5 km satellite-gauge estimate (CHIRPS), not a gauge on this farm.
Temperature anomalies come from a ~50 km grid cell (NASA POWER); absolute values do not reflect farm elevation.
10 m satellite pixels blend coffee with shade trees, bananas, and paths. Young coffee (under ~3 years) is hard to tell from bare ground.
Soil values are model predictions (iSDAsoil), not lab tests of this farm.
Speech recognition can mishear. The farmer confirmed every value by tapping before it entered the report.
Yield is not measured. Delivered quantities are only as reliable as the cooperative's records.
{n} claim(s) do not match independent records. Consider a site visit before deciding.
Unaltered: this report matches the code the farmer approved.
Does not match: this report differs from what the farmer approved. Do not rely on it.
